cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Review the key vocabulary for this session below:

cosy-blockquote.p: Cinematic – Relating to literature or motion pictures; having qualities characteristic of films.

p.em: Example: The women perform a hilarious parody of cinematic slow-motion walking in action movies.

cosy-blockquote.p: Absurdity – The quality or state of being ridiculous or wildly unreasonable.

p.em: Example: The song exposes the absurdity of movie tropes that make walking look dramatic.

cosy-blockquote.p: Exaggeration – A statement that represents something as better or worse than it really is.

p.em: Example: Slow-motion walking in real life is an awkward exaggeration that causes windburn.

cosy-blockquote.p: Glamour – An attractive or exciting quality that makes certain people or things seem appealing.

p.em: Example: Media creates fake glamour around mundane daily moments like walking down the street.

cosy-blockquote.p: Pacing – The speed at which something happens or is done.

p.em: Example: Slowing down your walking pacing in public looks bizarre to passersby.

cosy-blockquote.p: Self-Conscious – Feeling undue awareness of oneself, one's appearance, or one's actions.

p.em: Example: Trying to look cool in public often makes people feel painfully self-conscious.

cosy-blockquote.p: Trope – A figurative or metaphorical use of a word or expression; a common or overused theme.

p.em: Example: The dramatic entrance is a classic movie trope used to build hero status.

cosy-blockquote.p: Windburn – Redness and irritation of the skin caused by exposure to wind.

p.em: Example: They joke that staring unblinking into the wind for cinematic effect just causes windburn.

cosy-blockquote.p: Awkwardness – The quality of an informal situation being embarrassing or difficult.

p.em: Example: In reality, walking in slow motion takes forever and creates extreme physical awkwardness.

cosy-blockquote.p: Parody – An imitation of the style of a particular writer, artist, or genre with deliberate exaggeration.

p.em: Example: The song is a brilliant parody of N.E.R.D. and 2000s hip-hop music videos.
